name: mcp_auto_loader_exa
description: Opt-in connection to Exa's official web-search MCP server (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp). Discovers two reviewed, read-only tools for neural/semantic web search and full-page content extraction over Exa's own web index — general internet retrieval, distinct from ToolUniverse's structured scientific-database tools. The hosted public server needs no API key for casual use; an optional key raises rate limits for production use.

tool_contracts.name: web_search_exa
tool_contracts.title: Search the web (Exa)
tool_contracts.description: Neural/semantic web search over Exa's own index. Describe the ideal page in natural language rather than keywords (e.g. 'blog post comparing React and Vue performance'). Use category:people or category:company to focus results. Returns clean, ready-to-use content from top results; follow up with exa_web_fetch_exa if the returned content is insufficient.

tool_contracts.name: web_fetch_exa
tool_contracts.title: Fetch a webpage's content (Exa)
tool_contracts.description: Read one or more webpages' full content as clean markdown. Use after exa_web_search_exa when the search result content is insufficient, or to read any known URL directly. Batch multiple URLs in one call.

EXA_MCP_URL.purpose: Endpoint URL for the opt-in Exa web-search MCP connection.
EXA_MCP_URL.without: Leave blank to keep this third-party MCP connection disabled. To enable, set this to https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp — the public endpoint requires no account for casual use.

EXA_API_KEY.purpose: Raises Exa's rate limits for production use of the web-search MCP connection.
EXA_API_KEY.without: Works at Exa's free/casual rate limit without it.

operation.description: Discover reviewed tools, generate proxy configurations, or call one reviewed tool.

tool_name.description: Reviewed MCP tool name, required when operation is call_tool.

tool_arguments.description: Search query or URL-fetch arguments for the selected tool.

return_schema.description: Reviewed Exa web-search MCP discovery data or structured tool result.
